replaceCombinations.from: Activated matching lymphocyte [transform] @ Living lymph node -> Antibody-making and memory cells
replaceCombinations.to: Activated matching lymphocyte [consume] + Living lymph node [transform] -> Responding lymph node

replaceCombinations.from: Antibody-making and memory cells [preserve] + Amino acids [consume] -> Matching antibodies
replaceCombinations.to: Responding lymph node [preserve] + Amino acids [consume] -> Matching antibodies

replaceCombinations.from: Antibody-coated bacteria [transform] + Engulfing white blood cells [preserve] -> White blood cells containing bacterial remains
replaceCombinations.to: Antibody-coated bacteria [consume] + Engulfing white blood cells [transform] -> White blood cells containing bacterial remains

goalReplacement.from: Make antibody-producing cells and keep memory cells -- Antibody-making and memory cells
goalReplacement.to: Grow antibody-producing and memory cells in the node -- Responding lymph node

noteAddition: The living node transforms into the same responding node: descendants remain embedded in its tissue, rather than appearing as large cells laid across an unchanged organ. Both node states are fixed at the same position and only one is present at a time. Antibody secretion preserves the responding node. Engulfment transforms the receiving white cell into its digestive state. Representative cell populations and molecular samples do not imply literal counts or stoichiometry.
